function: Estimation of the near-field XL-MIMO channel (LoS plus NLoS paths): a Pix2pix GAN refines an initial linear estimate, pp. 4-6.
system: Near-field XL-MIMO with hybrid precoding, ULAs, Nt = 256 transmit and Nr = 128 receive antennas, 50 GHz carrier, no RIS, pp. 3, 9.
method: Pix2pix GAN variant (CNN U-Net generator, patch discriminator) with adversarial plus L1 loss, η = 100; supervised offline training, online prediction, pp. 5-10.
data_channel: Own simulated mixed LoS/NLoS near-field channel of [24], L = 3 NLoS paths, random angles, gains and distances; 4000 training and 1000 test samples, p. 9.
test_conditions: Trained and tested at SNR = 10 dB on separate samples of one channel model; sweeps over distance, pilot length, SNR; no unseen scenario stated, pp. 9-11.
baselines: Non-learned: far-field codebook OMP [12], two-stage algorithm [24], CRLB [24]; own variant IE-Pix2pix without initial estimate; no earlier learned estimator, pp. 9-11.
metrics: NMSE (eq. 22) versus distance, pilot length, SNR and training epochs, pp. 9-12.
complexity: Order of complexity in eq. (24): O(Nt Nr (Nt + Nr) + CNN term over layers), compared with OMP and two-stage orders; no runtime, p. 9.
openness: none; samples generated from the channel model of [24], no code or data link, p. 9.
q1_support: p. 9: "we adopt the mixed LoS/NLoS XL-MIMO near-field channel model proposed in [24]"; own samples with L = 3 paths and random angles and gains. Missing: any 3GPP, COST 2100 or DeepMIMO model, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 10: "In Fig. 5, we train and test the proposed IE-Pix2pix under SNR = 10 dB."; p. 9: "The training set and test set consist of 4000 and 1000 samples, respectively." Missing: a test on a scenario or setting not used in training; the sweeps of Figs. 7 to 9 do not say a trained model is reused.
q3_support: p. 9: "the two stage algorithm proposed for the adopted channel model [24], the CRLB, and the far-field codebook based OMP scheme [12]" are all non-learned. Missing: an earlier learned estimator; the only network compared is the IE-Pix2pix without the IE (p. 11), a variant of the proposed method.
q4_support: p. 9: "The computational complexity of the proposed IE-Pix2pix comes from two parts"; eq. (24) gives O(Nt Nr (Nt + Nr) + sum of Fs,h Fs,w Ks^2 Ns Ns-1) with the Table II layer sizes, and eq. (23) gives the two-stage baseline.
q5_support: p. 9: "we generate channel samples to train and test the proposed IE-Pix2pix". Missing: a code or data link or DOI, and any public dataset; the implementation is only stated as Python 3.7.16 with Tensorflow 2.2.0.
notes: RIS appears only in related work (p. 2) and references, not in the system. The PDF is the arXiv v2 preprint (2402.17281v2, 17 Jun 2024; it states acceptance on 15 June 2024) and prints no DOI. The x-axis of Fig. 8 reads SNR (dB) but its caption and values are pilot lengths (p. 11). The claim of surpassing the CRLB is in the abstract (p. 1) and in Figs. 7 and 8.
